{{Top|leg}}
The '''Okara Droid Company''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of the planet, the company's [[Okara Droid Factory|factory]] was taken over by rogue droids.
